title: Implement Faraday Working MVP
description: Implement the next-phase Faraday Working MVP described in docs/PRD.md. Scope includes Swift daemon/overlay, Bun TUI, calibrated forbidden/acceptable proximity model, simulation source, iBeacon scan/select setup, dry-run/armed enforcement, native overlay, native lock adapter, unlock/session notifications, JSON/JSONL persistence, and user LaunchAgent smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: docs/PRD.md exists as the source of truth; old v0 PRD is archived; implementation issues can be derived from the PRD; issue carries ready-for-agent label.

title: Add local persistence and event log
description:
## What to build
Persist local state and event records needed to inspect whether Faraday works. Store settings, calibration data if present, session lifecycle events, warnings, violations, lock events, missing-beacon events, and emergency events. Expose current status for a future local dashboard.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Settings for configured beacon and classifier thresholds save and load locally.
- [ ] Session, violation, missing-beacon, lock, and emergency events record timestamps.
- [ ] Current daemon/session status can be read through a local boundary.
- [ ] Persistence tests verify emitted records for major transitions.
- [ ] No cloud account, sync, subscription, or remote analytics dependency is introduced.

## Blocked by
faraday-4a0, faraday-heq, faraday-dk5

title: Integrate beacon allowlist scanner
description:
## What to build
Connect CoreBluetooth scanning to the classifier input shape. The scanner should discover advertisements for a configured iBeacon and emit timestamped RSSI observations only when UUID plus major/minor match the allowlist.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Config supports identifying the configured beacon by UUID plus major/minor.
- [ ] Scanner emits timestamped RSSI observations in the classifier input shape.
- [ ] Non-matching BLE advertisements are ignored.
- [ ] Scanner lifecycle can start and stop cleanly.
- [ ] Manual/integration notes describe validation with a real configurable iBeacon.

## Blocked by
faraday-dy6

title: Implement missing-beacon enforcement path
description:
## What to build
Implement missing-beacon behavior during and outside strict sessions. Missing outside strict session warns only. Missing after near or unknown during strict session is unsafe. Missing after far-confirmed enters grace, then unsafe if grace expires.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Missing outside strict session does not lock and emits warning/status only.
- [ ] Missing after near or unknown during strict session is unsafe.
- [ ] Missing after far-confirmed enters grace/warning instead of instant lock.
- [ ] Missing beyond configured grace emits unsafe enforcement behavior.
- [ ] Tests cover missing outside session, after far, after near, and grace expiry.

## Blocked by
faraday-heq

title: Implement strict session start flow
description:
## What to build
Implement strict session startup through the session state machine. Starting focus requires the configured beacon to be alive and near, then instructs the user to move the phone away, and activates only after sustained far confirmation.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Start Focus is refused when the beacon is missing.
- [ ] Start Focus is refused or held when the beacon is not confirmed near/alive.
- [ ] Near confirmation emits a move-phone-away instruction.
- [ ] Session becomes active only after sustained far confirmation.
- [ ] Tests cover missing-at-start, near-confirmed setup, transient far, and sustained far activation.

## Blocked by
faraday-dy6

title: Implement unsafe proximity lock path
description:
## What to build
Implement the active-session path where the beacon becomes near again. Sustained near should enter an unsafe countdown, emit a warning overlay command, cancel if far-confirmed returns, and emit a native-lock command if unsafe persists.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Active session enters warning/countdown after sustained near violation.
- [ ] Countdown emits an overlay-ready enforcement command.
- [ ] Countdown cancels when far-confirmed returns before expiry.
- [ ] Lock command emits when unsafe state persists through countdown.
- [ ] Post-unlock recheck relocks or re-enters enforcement when still unsafe.
- [ ] Tests verify lock decisions through a mock adapter only.

## Blocked by
faraday-4a0

title: Implement RSSI classification tracer
description:
## What to build
Build the first end-to-end tracer for RSSI classification. Synthetic timestamped observations for a configured beacon should produce near, far, uncertain, or missing classifications using smoothing, hysteresis, and sustained-time rules.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Synthetic RSSI observations feed the classifier without CoreBluetooth.
- [ ] Defaults classify sustained strong RSSI as near and sustained weak RSSI as far.
- [ ] Missing classification occurs after the configured timeout.
- [ ] Boundary noise does not rapidly flap between near and far.
- [ ] Tests cover sustained near, brief near spike, sustained far, missing timeout, and noisy boundary behavior.

## Blocked by
faraday-ned

title: Scaffold Swift macOS app core
description:
## What to build
Create the initial Swift macOS app/daemon scaffold with testable module boundaries for Faraday. Establish empty seams for scanner input, RSSI classification, strict session state, enforcement, calibration, persistence, and launchd integration.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Repo has a minimal Swift macOS project/package structure.
- [ ] At least one core module and one test target exist.
- [ ] Placeholder interfaces or types exist for each deep module boundary.
- [ ] Test target runs with a smoke test.
- [ ] No automated test can lock the developer Mac.

## Blocked by
faraday-7xe

title: Finish open-source repo foundation
description:
## What to build
Finalize the repo foundation for the Apache-2.0 open-source Faraday app. Keep project planning centralized in docs and Beads, remove local markdown issue artifacts, and make the repo posture clear before implementation starts.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] LICENSE exists and uses Apache-2.0.
- [ ] README explains Faraday, open-source posture, BYO beacon support, and primary docs.
- [ ] docs/PRD.md, docs/PRODUCT.md, docs/BEACONS.md, and CONTEXT.md exist and agree on the open-source app plus staged hardware strategy.
- [ ] .scratch local issue artifacts are removed.
- [ ] Agent skill docs point to Beads for issue tracking.

## Blocked by
None - can start immediately
close_reason: Repo planning centralized in docs and Beads; open-source foundation and initial beacon compatibility guide added.

title: Build end-to-end MVP validation harness
description:
## What to build
Create the real-world MVP validation harness for Faraday: manual beacon validation, setup checklist, session test script, five-workday usage review, and metric capture for phone-at-desk time, false lockouts, emergency use, and bypass attempts.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checklist covers hardware setup for a configurable iBeacon attached to the phone/case.
- [ ] Manual script validates session start, far activation, near violation countdown/lock, missing-beacon grace/lock, and emergency mode.
- [ ] Five-workday review template captures two sessions per day, phone-at-desk duration, false lockouts, emergency use, and bypass attempts.
- [ ] Validation records whether PRD success metrics pass or fail.
- [ ] Findings can feed future Beads issues.

## Blocked by
faraday-eck, faraday-c9p, faraday-16z, faraday-wnv

title: Decide launchd weak-moment resistance posture
description:
## What to build
Make the human-reviewed launchd and weak-moment resistance decision. Decide whether MVP uses a user LaunchAgent, root-owned LaunchDaemon, or staged support for both, then capture the tradeoff as an ADR and install/remove docs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Human-reviewed decision records user LaunchAgent vs root-owned LaunchDaemon vs staged support.
- [ ] docs/adr/ contains an ADR for launchd enforcement posture.
- [ ] Install, restart, and remove steps are documented.
- [ ] KeepAlive/restart behavior is included for MVP operation.
- [ ] Docs state weak-moment resistance limits clearly for local-admin users.
- [ ] Smoke/manual test instructions verify startup and restart behavior.

## Blocked by
faraday-heq, faraday-y1t

title: Validate first real beacon with scanner
description:
## What to build
Validate one real bring-your-own compatible iBeacon with the Faraday scanner and classifier. Use the result to update the compatibility list with concrete device status and setup notes.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least one real configurable iBeacon is tested with the scanner.
- [ ] UUID, major/minor, transmit power, advertising interval, and battery notes are recorded where available.
- [ ] Desk and target-room RSSI behavior is captured.
- [ ] docs/BEACONS.md lists the device as tested, likely-compatible, or unsupported.
- [ ] Any scanner or classifier gaps discovered during validation become Beads issues.

## Blocked by
faraday-7za and hardware in hand

title: Implement guided calibration path
description:
## What to build
Implement optional guided calibration for RSSI thresholds. The user measures beacon RSSI at desk, doorway/hall, and target room. Calibration derives near/far thresholds and confidence notes while preserving defaults when skipped.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Calibration collects labeled sample sets for desk, doorway/hall, and target room.
- [ ] Calibration output includes derived near/far thresholds and confidence notes.
- [ ] Defaults remain available when calibration is skipped or incomplete.
- [ ] Calibration data is stored separately from live RSSI observations.
- [ ] Tests cover representative desk, doorway, and target-room sample sets.

## Blocked by
faraday-dy6, faraday-y1t

title: Implement Emergency Co-work Mode
description:
## What to build
Implement Emergency Co-work Mode as a short, logged exception during a strict session. The user provides a reason, waits through a deliberate delay, receives 10 minutes of phone-and-Mac coexistence, can extend once, then must move the phone far again.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Emergency mode requires a user-provided reason.
- [ ] Emergency mode starts only after a configured 30-60 second delay.
- [ ] Emergency mode suppresses unsafe near-lock behavior for the configured duration.
- [ ] Exactly one extension is allowed and later extension attempts are refused.
- [ ] Emergency start, extension, refusal, and expiration events are logged.
- [ ] After expiration, strict session requires far-confirmed before normal continuation.

## Blocked by
faraday-heq, faraday-y1t

title: Draft beacon compatibility buying guide
description:
## What to build
Create the first useful beacon compatibility and buying guide for bring-your-own iBeacons before scanner implementation exists. Focus on what users should buy, which settings matter, and how future validation will be recorded.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] docs/BEACONS.md explains required beacon capabilities.
- [ ] Buying guidance distinguishes tested, likely-compatible, and unsupported devices.
- [ ] Recommended starting settings are documented without requiring Faraday-branded hardware.
- [ ] Validation checklist is ready for later real-device testing.

## Blocked by
None - can start immediately
close_reason: Repo planning centralized in docs and Beads; open-source foundation and initial beacon compatibility guide added.

title: Evaluate recommended beacon kit viability
description:
## What to build
After real-world validation, evaluate whether Faraday should move from compatibility-list-only to a recommended third-party beacon kit. Keep this as product strategy, not MVP software scope.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Decision uses validation harness findings and beacon compatibility evidence.
- [ ] Recommendation says stay compatibility-list-only, sell recommended kit, or defer.
- [ ] If kit is recommended, required support, warranty, fulfillment, and setup-material work is listed as follow-up.
- [ ] Decision preserves bring-your-own beacon as a first-class path.

## Blocked by
faraday-5zr
